newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai shares ended down sharply on crackdown.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai shares ended down sharply on crackdown.

text.p: Shanghai's A and B stock indices ended sharply down on Thursday after Beijing imposed new curbs on the trading of shares by state-owned companies, barring them from making "speculative" deals, brokers said.

The B index fell 5.592 points or 6.34 percent to 82.583 points on volume of 22.021 million shares worth $16.107 million while the A index tumbled 126.006 points or 8.90 percent to 1,290.113 on turnover of 8.44 billion yuan.
The ban, following other measures to cool down the stock markets, greatly weakened market sentiment, resulting in panic selling, brokers said.
